##: Doubao Work is the productivity brand of 豆包, but the desktop button on doubao.com/work hands out the same Windows client as doubao.com/download/desktop: the surl-token table in the web bundle only varies the attribution suffix, not the binary.
Windows x64 packaging only. The vendor also publishes Doubao_Arm64_installer_<version>.exe in the same folder, but this bucket mirrors feishu and ships the x64 build alone.

The installer is a custom PE (Beijing Chuntian Zhiyun, the Lark/Feishu 'Saman' framework), not NSIS or Inno: its payload is a zstd stream in resource .rsrc\2052\ZIP\<id>, which expands to a 1.7 GB PAX tar holding the installed tree flat at the root. 7-Zip unpacks the PE and leaves the tar as a file named '<id>~', so the payload is a two-stage job and installer.script re-runs 7-Zip on whatever '*~' the first stage produced.

Extracting the tar is equivalent to running the installer with --command=quiet_install --target_dir=<dir>: the tar already carries lark_settings, 'First Run' and launcher\uninstall.exe, so the vendor installer only untars it and then writes the registry, file associations and startup entry, which Scoop deliberately skips.

checkver reads the vendor's own upgrade-check endpoint. data.version is the minimum supported build (1.49.10, with a 'please upgrade' notice), data.newest_version is the build actually published under doubao_pc/.
The CDN publishes no checksum, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and Excavator recomputes the SHA-256 from the download.
description: Doubao Work desktop client, ByteDance's AI assistant for research, writing, data work and app building
notes: The GUI executable is Doubao.exe and is shimmed as 'doubao-work'; the running processes are named DoubaoX.
Profile, cache and logs live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Doubao and %APPDATA%\Doubao, so nothing is persisted by Scoop.

Because the vendor installer is not run, there is no doubao:// protocol handler, Explorer context menu or autostart entry. Launch the app once from the shortcut if you want its own startup registration.

The bundled updater (update.exe) and the launcher in launcher\ are left in place, but an in-app update rewrites files inside the Scoop app directory; decline it and run 'scoop update doubao-work' instead.
